titles: "이 이름을 꺼내지 마라" 유학생 53만 명이 한 해 만에 되돌아온 진짜 이유
"검색해도 안 나옵니다" 중국이 지운 계획 하나가 53만 명을 집으로 돌려보낸 이유
"3억 쓰고 105만 원 받는다" 돌아온 유학생 53만 명이 마주한 자리의 정체
thumbnail_texts: "이름부터 지우고 시작했다" / 53만 명이 되돌아온 자리 / 여긴 자리가 없대요
"검색해도 이젠 안 나옵니다" / 53만 명을 되돌린 그 계획 / 켕겼나 보네

meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 돌아온 자리를 접수 창구 하나로 압축한 컷. 2026년 대졸자 1,270만 명에 귀국자 53만 5,600명이 얹혀 구직 대군이 1,500만 명을 넘는다는 걸 「마감 팻말」 하나로 물리화했다. 국가 대 국가가 아니라 중국 국가와 중국 청년의 관계이므로 양쪽 다 오성홍기 구체를 쓰고 크기와 복장으로 위치를 갈랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth polished exhibition-hall floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A large countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — sits behind a heavy steel reception counter on the right in a dark clerk's business suit, its eyes squeezed into smug crescents and its mouth curled in a lazy half-smile as its small black gloved hand sets down a metal desk plate reading "접수 마감" in Korean Hangul at mid height. Facing it from the left, a smaller countryball sphere in the same Chinese flag wrapping wears a graduation gown with the hood pushed back and grips the handle of a wheeled suitcase, its pupils shrunk to pinpricks, its eyebrows driven into a hard V, its mouth wrenched open in a shout and a red anger mark throbbing on its surface, waving a fistful of resumes across the counter. Between and behind them the counter is buried under a leaning tower of resume folders and a stamped-out ticket dispenser, with three or four loose sheets tumbling through the air on motion trails. The background is a blurred daylight job-fair hall of grey partition booths under a wash of dull green-grey light with a single red banner accent high above.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 궈카오 지원자 371만 8,000명, 평균 98대 1, 한 자리에 6,470명이 몰린 쏠림을 끝없는 책상 열로 그렸다. 「돌아왔지만 결국 시험장에 다시 앉는다」가 이번 편의 착지점이라 스케일 대비로 간다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth pale examination-hall floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A colossal examination hall seen in deep perspective: rank after rank of identical steel desks recede toward a vanishing point high in the frame, each one occupied by a small countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — the rows shrinking and blurring into a grey haze so the sense of number never stops. In the near foreground on the right, one such sphere is drawn large in a plain white shirt and loosened tie, its glossy surface reflecting the overhead lights, its eyes stretched wide with the whites showing, a single fat tear hanging at the lower rim, its mouth open in a small helpless gasp and cartoon shaking lines vibrating around its head as its black gloved hands press flat on a blank answer sheet at mid height. Above the rows a red banner stretched across the far wall reads "고사장" in Korean Hangul, the smaller notices beneath it printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Cold institutional light from above, desaturated grey-blue everywhere except the red banner and the flag surfaces.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 메이퇀 배달원 750만 명 중 대졸 이상이 38만 명, 배달기사 월 6,803위안이라는 수치를 얼굴 하나로 바꾼 컷. 「3억 쓰고 105만 원 받습니다」는 카피 ③번 세트와 직접 맞물린다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain grey asphalt — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A single countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — fills most of the upper frame in a tight close-up, wearing a scuffed courier helmet with the chin strap hanging loose and a bulky insulated delivery box strapped to its small body, one black gloved hand hooked over the box lid at mid height. Its cartoon eyes are forced wide open but completely unfocused, the highlights in them dulled to grey, its mouth clamped into a flat straight line with the corners barely twitching, one bead of sweat sliding down the glossy red surface beside its eye. Behind it a blurred Chinese city street at dusk with a row of parked electric scooters and other courier boxes reduced to soft shapes, neon reflections smeared across wet asphalt. The lighting is a cold blue evening key with one warm shop-sign glow behind the helmet, and the sphere's flag stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at small size.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 「이 이름을 꺼내지 마라」를 그대로 그림으로 옮긴 컷. 2018년 9월 노출 금지 지침과 2020년 4월 검색 차단을 검은 페인트 롤러 한 자루로 물리화했고, 그걸 보고 놀란 유학생 구체를 옆에 세워 인과의 양끝을 한 화면에 담았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a polished dark lobby floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A large countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — stands on the right in a dark double-breasted suit, reaching up with a black gloved hand to drag a dripping black paint roller across a heavy brass wall plaque reading "천인계획" in Korean Hangul, the right half of the letters already swallowed by wet black paint that runs down the marble in thick streaks. Its eyes are swivelled hard to the side away from the plaque in an exaggerated sidelong glance, one eyebrow raised, its mouth pursed into a stiff little whistle shape, a single sweat drop popping off its glossy surface. On the left a smaller sphere in the same flag wrapping wears a graduation gown and holds a stack of resumes half-lowered, its eyes bulging with the whites fully showing, its mouth hanging open and three cartoon shock lines radiating from its head. Between them a paint bucket sits on a stepladder at mid height with flecks of black paint suspended in the air on motion trails. The background is a blurred grey institutional lobby, cool light from a high window, with the red of the two spheres and the brass plaque as the only saturated colours.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목이 약속한 「한 해 만에 되돌아온 진짜 이유」의 결과 장면. 나간 57만 명 중 94%가 돌아온 역대 최고 귀국률을, 내려앉는 출국 셔터와 그 앞에 멈춰 선 캐리어 행렬로 그렸다. 문을 닫게 만든 쪽이 뒤에서 손을 감추고 있다는 배치로 자업자득 인과를 유지한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — plain pale concrete ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. A colossal ribbed steel shutter fills the centre of the frame, grinding down to just above mid height with a heavy padlock and chain already looped through its handle, harsh sparks skittering off the rail where it bites shut, and above it a terminal sign reading "출국장" in Korean Hangul with the smaller notices beside it printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. In front of the shutter on the left, a large countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — stands in a dark suit with both black gloved hands hidden behind its back, one of them still smeared with wet black paint, its eyes rolled innocently upward and its mouth pulled into a tight thin line, a sweat bead clinging to its glossy surface. On the right a smaller sphere in the same flag wrapping, in a graduation gown, is caught mid step-back with the handle of a wheeled suitcase in its gloved hand, its pupils shrunk to pinpricks and its mouth an open square of alarm, with a further row of tiny identical spheres and suitcases queued behind it, blurring into haze. Cool grey terminal light, one red emergency lamp glowing above the shutter.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목의 「이 이름을 꺼내지 마라」가 만드는 감정 스위치를 얼굴 하나로 밀어붙이는 컷. 카피 ②번의 리액션 「켕겼나 보네」와 정확히 붙는 표정이고, 뒤로 캐리어 행렬을 흐리게 깔아 원인과 결과를 한 화면에 남겼다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — an open pale overcast sky — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. An extreme close-up of one large countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — filling the upper frame in a dark suit with a stiff mandarin collar, tilted slightly away from the lens. Its cartoon eyes are rolled up and off to the corner in an obvious act of feigned innocence, the pupils tiny, one eyebrow arched high and the other flat, its mouth puckered into a whistling O, three fat sweat drops flying off the glossy red surface and a single nervous shaking line beside its cheek. Its small black gloved hand is raised only as far as its own collar, tugging it away from an imaginary sweat at mid height. Far behind it and thrown deeply out of focus, a thin file of tiny spheres with wheeled suitcases trails across the frame from left to right, reduced to soft red smudges. Bright flat daylight with a strong specular highlight riding the top of the sphere, saturated red against a washed-out grey-white sky.

On the left, one large countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — is framed chest-up and close to the lens in a dark business suit, its cartoon eyes aimed straight down toward the camera, the lower lids tense, its mouth locked into a hard flat line with the corners dragged down, two sweat beads sliding down the glossy surface and its black gloved hands kept low and out of frame. On the right, a daylight job fair where a line of much smaller spheres in the same flag wrapping, each in a graduation gown and each towing a wheeled suitcase and clutching a resume folder, waits at grey reception counters, the queue bending once and shrinking into soft haze, with a counter banner above them reading "채용관" in Korean Hangul and every smaller notice printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. High in the upper right corner a large Chinese flag hangs against the hall wall as the only strong red mass on that side. The palette is drained grey-green daylight with the flag red as the single accent, and a thin vertical seam of light separates the two halves.

A horizontal eye-level frame whose left half is filled almost entirely by one countryball sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — cropped so close that the top of the sphere touches the upper edge, wearing a rumpled shirt with the tie yanked loose at the collar; its cartoon eyes are half-lidded and aimed straight down toward the camera, the highlights in them almost gone, the corners of its mouth pulled down into a small resigned curve, a single slow tear rolling along the glossy red surface and one limp black gloved hand hanging at mid height holding a single crumpled resume sheet.
